text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(It's quiet. So very quiet, and yet— 
the crowd's excitement is vibrating 
through the air...!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(In this wide-open place with nothing in 
the way, 
all I can feel are the expectations, the 
heat, and—)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one who's gonna wiiiiin!! 
Haaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
......ugh, gh!!!! 
No, no! I will—!!!!

The moment they crossed the finish line, 
a shaft of light pierced the 
clouds—illuminating the victor.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! Amidst all that hype, 
she's the one who won?!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't Almond Eye or Daring Tact... 
Man, this is why racing is so incredible!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (Clap, clap, clap, clap...!!)

Every single spectator in the stands 
united— 
offering thunderous applause to the winner 
who had achieved a brilliant victory at 
the pinnacle of racing.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *gasp*...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—Argh, seriously, this is so 
frustrating...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Almond Eye...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact, there's no way 
I'm letting this be the end!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'm coming back right away... and I will 
win next time! 
Almond Eye doesn't just stand still, you 
know!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(Almond Eye... She should have burned 
through everything. 
Yet a brand-new fire is already blazing 
inside her...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
That's why you've stayed so strong for so 
long. 
That's why...—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye... Even so, the history you've 
made 
will never fade. 
No one can ever take that away from 
you...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye... thank you for giving us 
such wonderful dreams...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: (...There are people crying in the crowd.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(Almond Eye's strength, her dazzling 
light— 
it struck right to their hearts.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: —You're still so far ahead of me...

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: ...What an incredible race.

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
...I'm still so far behind. For now. 
Even so—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... 
I'm so sorry.
choice_data_list: Don't be. You ran brilliantly out there.
Don't be. You ran brilliantly out there.

text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact gave a performance truly 
worthy 
of the current Triple Tiara champion. It 
was just—
choice_data_list:
As of right now, our opponent was simply 
too strong.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
From your perspective, Trainer, 
what was the difference between Almond Eye 
and me?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Even after losing, Almond Eye immediately 
lit a new flame within herself.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
That resilience is what forged all her 
history up to now... 
I believe that's where the difference 
lies.

After claiming the Triple Tiara, 
Almond Eye tackled the classic route, went 
abroad, 
and carved out a path all her own.
choice_data_list:
I think it's the sheer weight of what 
she's built up.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...In that case, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Do you believe that with more experience, 
I too... 
can become a horsegirl that anyone would 
call 
"overwhelmingly strong"?

It was, without a doubt, the sprouting of 
ambition. 
Through this very race, Daring Tact had 
awakened— 
to her pride as a "champion."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, do you think I can... 
become a more certain, unwavering light?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you so much.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to let things end here. 
I want to win on an even greater stage.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Not just as a horsegirl 
from Hidaka, but—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
—as the Triple Tiara horsegirl everyone 
cheered for... 
I want to show them an even grander 
dream...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please help me think of one. 
A path where I can shine even brighter...!

While Daring Tact was getting ready, 
I considered several paths she could take 
for her Senior Year. The conclusion was—
choice_data_list: I'd like us to focus on the classic route.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean... targeting races like 
today's? 
Aiming for premier medium-distance events?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, because they draw the most 
attention.

Yeah, because they draw the most 
attention.

text_block_list.text:
Of course, I still intend for her to run 
the Tiara route. 
However, she can't be contained by just 
that—
choice_data_list: Let's go beyond the Triple Tiara!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...! 
Beyond...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, I want to reach it. 
Please lead the way!

That said, Daring Tact has spent this past 
year 
in intense battles, claiming the Triple 
Tiara 
and facing her seniors. First, a rest is 
in order—
choice_data_list:
Let's kick things off with the Kinko Sho 
in March.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...You were careful about spacing out 
my races during my Junior Year as well.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Right now, I can believe 
that taking my time is the right choice.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to working with you again 
next year!

title: After the Japan Cup: The Next Light
